meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会接手 v1→v2 迁移的收尾:检查迁移报告,帮你确认新版机器人能收到真实消息,确认并设置管理员,搬移旧记忆,核对容器配置,处理你的 v1 定制代码,最后做健康检查。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from v1”“finish migration”“v1 migration”时触发;若迁移脚本还没跑,它会先让你跑 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 再继续。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾。
say.note: 读取迁移报告并开始分阶段处理。

say.text: 把旧版记忆迁移到新版本。
say.note: 会运行记忆迁移并更新共享记忆。

say.text: 帮我看看 v1 的定制代码怎么处理。
say.note: 会列出定制提交让你选择方式。

howto.what_en: Claude finishes a NanoClaw v1→v2 migration: reviews the handoff report, verifies routing, sets the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, handles v1 customizations, and runs a health check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “migrate from v1”, “finish migration”, or “v1 migration”. It only continues after `bash migrate-v2.sh` has run; otherwise it tells you to run that first.

say_en.text: Help me finish the v1 to v2 migration.
say_en.note: Reads the handoff report and starts the steps.

say_en.text: Migrate my legacy memory to the new version.
say_en.note: Runs the memory migration for imported groups.

say_en.text: How should I handle my v1 custom code?
say_en.note: Shows your fork commits and asks how to proceed.
